exposure: Preconception HbA1c levels (categorized as no diabetes: HbA1c <5.7%, or prediabetes: HbA1c ≥5.7% to <6.5%)
cohort: Birthing individuals aged 10 to 24 years with no history of diabetes and at least one preconception HbA1c test, residing in New York, New York.
finding: Preconception prediabetes among adolescents and young adults was associated with more than twice the risk of gestational diabetes at first birth, and with small increases in the likelihood of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Preconception prediabetes was associated with an increased, but not statistically significant, risk for cesarean delivery.
